description: Source file implementing utility functions for certificate verification, including reading, parsing, and handling certificates in PEM, DER, and PKCS#7 formats, as well as printing debug and error information.

methods.name: ExtractCertificatesFromData
methods.description: Parses input data as PEM, PKCS#7, or DER certificates and populates a vector of CertInput structures.

methods.name: ReadCertificatesFromFile
methods.description: Reads certificate data from a file and extracts certificates into a vector.

methods.name: ReadChainFromFile
methods.description: Reads a certificate chain from a file, separating target and intermediates.

methods.name: ReadFromFile
methods.description: Reads entire file content into a string.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file.

methods.name: PrintCertError
methods.description: Outputs an error message related to a certificate.

methods.name: PrintDebugData
methods.description: Prints debug information about trust store data, conditionally compiled for Mac.

methods.name: FingerPrintCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 fingerprint of a certificate buffer.

methods.name: SubjectFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Extracts the subject's display name from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: SubjectFromCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate from a crypto buffer and extracts its subject name.
